skill.name: humanode-agentlink
skill.description: AgentLink gives an AI agent a verified, human-backed on-chain identity. Use it to link and register an agent wallet with a biomapped human owner in BiomapperAgentRegistry, verify active AgentLink status on Base mainnet, sign HTTP requests with the agent key, validate agentlink headers, and access supported partner endpoints. Covers the AgentLink CLI encrypted keystore and external signers through the SDK.
skill.summary: Link AI agents to biomapped human owners and sign authenticated requests on Base.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: Most command and reconnaissance detections are Markdown false positives. The skill still handles wallet private keys and sends signed identity data to third-party services. It also advertises an X raid endpoint, creating a high-confidence abuse concern.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the X raid endpoint and prohibit workflows that coordinate deceptive engagement, spam, or platform manipulation.
Make an external KMS or HSM signer the default. Clearly warn users never to place private keys in prompts, source files, or logs.
Pin exact CLI and SDK versions. Publish provenance and integrity guidance before asking users to run community packages with wallet keys.
Require domain allowlisting, explicit user approval, and clear data disclosures before sending signed headers or request content.

content.user_title: Link AI Agents to Human-Verified On-Chain Identity
content.value_statement: AI agents need a verifiable identity before trusted services can accept their requests. AgentLink guides wallet linking, status checks, request signing, and partner access on Base.
actual_capabilities: Guides encrypted CLI keystore setup and derives the agent wallet address.
Generates a linker request for a biomapped human owner on Base.
Checks whether the agent is linked and the owner biomapping remains active.
Shows SDK signing with either a raw key or an external signer.
Builds signed AgentLink headers and demonstrates authenticated partner requests.
limitations: A biomapped human must review and sign the link transaction.
The documented registry profile supports Base mainnet only.
The workflow handles wallet keys and depends on third-party CLI and SDK packages.
Partner availability, pricing, limits, and policies can change independently.

use_cases.title: Register a New Agent
use_cases.description: Create an agent wallet, prepare the human linking flow, and confirm active registry status.

use_cases.title: Integrate Isolated Signing
use_cases.description: Connect an existing KMS or HSM signer without placing the private key in the agent process.

use_cases.title: Access Verified Partner Services
use_cases.description: Prepare authenticated requests for approved partner endpoints after confirming the agent remains active.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up an Agent Wallet
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through creating an AgentLink wallet identity on Base. Use the encrypted CLI keystore and stop before any human signature step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup with local encrypted key storage.

prompt_templates.title: Link and Verify an Owner
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me generate a linker request for owner {owner_address}. Explain what the human must review, then show how to verify linked and active status.
prompt_templates.scenario: Human-approved wallet linking and status verification.

prompt_templates.title: Connect an External Signer
prompt_templates.prompt: Integrate AgentLink into my TypeScript agent using an external signer. My signer exposes {sign_method}, and the public address is {agent_address}.
prompt_templates.scenario: Production integration with KMS, HSM, or secret-manager signing.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Secure Request Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a secure signed-request flow for {endpoint}. Include domain allowlisting, signer isolation, status checks, replay considerations, logging rules, and failure handling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced security review for authenticated partner access.

output_examples.input: Prepare a safe AgentLink setup checklist for a new self-hosted agent.
output: Install a pinned CLI version from a verified source.
Create the encrypted keystore without exposing the key in chat or logs.
Record the derived public wallet address.
Ask the biomapped owner to review the linker transaction before signing.

output_examples.input: Explain how to use AgentLink when the key is stored in an HSM.
output_examples.output: Use the external-signer option with the public agent address and an HSM-backed signing callback. The private key should remain inside the HSM.

output_examples.input: Check whether an agent is ready to call a partner service.
output: Confirm the configured network is Base mainnet.
Verify linked and active status before each sensitive workflow.
Approve the destination domain and review the data being sent.
Use the isolated signer to create the request authentication header.

best_practices: Prefer an external KMS or HSM signer for production agents.
Verify destination domains and human-reviewed transactions before signing.
Pin package versions and recheck active status before sensitive requests.
anti_patterns: Never place a wallet private key in prompts, source control, or logs.
Do not open linker URLs or sign transactions without human review.
Do not assume a linked agent remains active after biomapping changes.

faq.question: What must the human owner complete first?
faq.answer: The owner must complete Humanode biomapping, bridge it to Base, and review the AgentLink transaction.

faq.question: Can the agent complete linking alone?
faq.answer: No. The agent prepares the linker request, but the biomapped human owner must review and sign it.

faq.question: Which network does this skill document?
faq.answer: It documents the AgentLink registry and partner flow on Base mainnet.

faq.question: How should the agent key be stored?
faq.answer: Use the encrypted CLI keystore for local setup. Prefer an external KMS or HSM signer for production.

faq.question: What does an inactive status mean?
faq.answer: The linked owner is not active in the current Biomapper generation. Partner access pauses until the owner completes biomapping again.

faq.question: Does the skill show server-side header validation?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on linking, status checks, client-side signing, and partner requests. It does not provide an inbound verification procedure.
